title: Golden Yellow Paper Towel Holder, 14-Inch Freestanding Countertop Valet, Solid Brass, Allied Brass
description:
Keep paper towels within easy reach while keeping your kitchen countertop clean and uncluttered in Golden Yellow, which radiates warm, sunny energy that brightens any kitchens with cheerful, optimistic personality. This freestanding paper towel holder valet is crafted from solid brass and features a weighted base to prevent tipping, plus a felt pad to help protect surfaces from scratches.

• Reduce countertop clutter with a dedicated paper towel stand
• Stay stable during one-handed tearing with a weighted base
• Protect counters with an integrated felt pad
• Coordinate your look with multiple designer finish options
• Backed by a limited lifetime warranty

Specs: 5 in L x 14 in H x 5 in W. Product weight: 4.8 lb. Mounting: freestanding (no wall mounting). Warranty: limited lifetime.
